# FUSE on continuous scores (generated by scripts/run_continuous.py)

## Part 1: simulated raters

1000 items, 10 raters. Rater j's score = shift_j + d_j * y + N(0, 1), d_j uniform on the given range (0.1-2.5 means some raters are near-useless and some excellent). 'Skewed' applies a different exp transform per rater. Mean over 10 seeds. Oracle = Bayes-optimal rule with the true parameters.

### Similar raters, balanced

| Method | AUC | Accuracy |
|---|---:|---:|
| Majority vote (median split) | 98.4 | 93.4 |
| Dawid-Skene (median split) | 98.6 | 93.9 |
| Dawid-Skene (5 bins) | 99.6 | 96.9 |
| Mean z-score | 99.7 |  |
| FUSE logistic (paper) | 99.6 | 96.5 |
| FUSE triplet posterior (paper) | 96.9 | 90.8 |
| FUSE product posterior | 96.8 | 91.0 |
| Oracle (true parameters) | 99.7 | 97.4 |

## Part 2: real score data

Dense matrices only (no missing entries), so no method can use missingness. Differences are paired bootstraps against Dawid-Skene with 5 bins.

### VIPER FFDM suspicion score, 15 readers x 93 cases

93 items (19 positive), 15 raters

| Method | AUC | Accuracy | AUC vs Dawid-Skene 5 bins (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Dawid-Skene (readers' own recall decision) | 78.3 | 69.9 | +1.0 [-3.6, +6.1] |
| Majority vote (median split) | 78.7 | 62.4 | +1.4 [-2.8, +6.3] |
| Dawid-Skene (median split) | 79.2 | 64.5 | +1.9 [-2.1, +6.4] |
| Dawid-Skene (5 bins) | 77.3 | 66.7 |  |
| Mean z-score | 78.4 |  | +1.1 [-1.8, +4.4] |
| FUSE logistic (paper) | 78.0 | 80.6 | +0.6 [-2.7, +4.6] |
| FUSE triplet posterior (paper) | 79.4 | 79.6 | +2.1 [-3.9, +8.6] |
| FUSE product posterior | 78.6 | 76.3 | +1.2 [-5.3, +7.9] |
